sections.heading: Essential oil sample kit packaging with a fitted vial insert
sections.text: Packaging applications Essential oil sample kit packaging with a fitted vial insert An essential oil sample box or fragrance sample kit needs cavities matched to the actual bottle geometry. Nominal liquid capacity alone is not enough: two bottles with the same capacity can have different diameters, shoulders and cap heights. This rigid vial box can be reviewed for a branded sampling set using measured bottles. Sample vial packaging boxes Provide bottle diameter, overall height including the cap, filled weight and vial count. Identify whether labels must face forward and whether the set is packed upright or laid flat. Custom EVA foam vial inserts Review cavity depth, finger access and the material between cavities on a physical sample. Test insertion and removal with the finished bottle and label; a tight fit should not require pulling the cap. Approve the complete sampling kit Include the leaflet, sample card and outer shipping carton in the packing brief. This is secondary presentation packaging, not a claim of leakproof containment or dangerous-goods shipping approval. Confirm transport requirements for the actual contents separately. sections.heading: Build the presentation around your product
sections.text: Customization Build the presentation around your product Logo & foil Review foil, print, emboss or deboss artwork against the chosen paper. Custom colour Use ivory, black, seasonal colours or a Pantone-matched wrapped paper. Fitted insert Set cavity count, product orientation and clearance from measured samples. Surface finish Compare matte, soft-touch, textured and other finish options at sampling.

sections.heading: What changes the quotation?
sections.text: Quote factors What changes the quotation? Finished dimensions, board and wrap grade, insert material, print coverage, finishing steps, quantity, packed carton dimensions, destination and Incoterms all affect the final scope. Ask for the same assumptions on every supplier quotation.

sections.heading: Buyer questions
sections.text: FAQ Buyer questions Can one outer box support different vial quantities? When the outer dimensions allow it, different cavity layouts can be developed by changing the insert while keeping the box structure consistent. What vial information is needed? Provide vial diameter, height, cap shape, quantity and any clearance or orientation requirements. Can the black exterior be changed? Yes. The wrapped paper colour, logo treatment and finish can be reviewed against the brand artwork. Is EVA the only insert option? EVA is shown for this product concept; paperboard or molded-pulp alternatives can be discussed if the protection and finish requirements allow.
